scope: Read-only adversarial review of the offline JSON recovery model, independent host-filesystem reproductions under temporary /private/tmp directories and full suite rerun.

reproductions.issue: Acknowledged schema and pack migrations lost after live graph corruption
reproductions.steps: Create temporary RecoveryHarness; commit accepted artifact; migrate_pack(firstparty.software,2,transform); overwrite graph_path with corrupt bytes; recover. Separately start graph schema 2, commit artifact, migrate(2), corrupt live graph and recover.
reproductions.before_fix: Successful pack migration restored without pack_versions; successful schema 3 migration restored schema 2.
reproductions.after_fix: Pack version firstparty.software=2 and migrated schema=3 survive corrupt-live-graph recovery.

reproductions.issue: Snapshot ordering metadata outside integrity checksum could hide later acknowledged mutations
reproductions.steps: Commit m-first then m-second; change only m-first snapshot sequence to 999; corrupt live graph; recover and inspect revision mutation IDs.
reproductions.before_fix: Older snapshot accepted with forged ordering; revisions contained only m-first while artifact held second bytes.
reproductions.after_fix: Full snapshot envelope integrity rejects ordering corruption; revision IDs remain m-first and m-second.

reproductions.issue: Pack migration callback could erase immutable global receipt history
reproductions.steps: Commit accepted artifact; call migrate_pack(firstparty.software,2,lambda payload:payload.update(receipts=[])); compare global receipts before and after.
reproductions.before_fix: Whole-state callback erased graph receipts and migration returned success.
reproductions.after_fix: Callback changes only pack_data[firstparty.software]; immutable global receipts remain equal to pre-migration history.

descriptor_review.source_inspection: ScopedFS retains opened project root; ancestor traversal and leaf opens use descriptor-relative O_NOFOLLOW; mutation retains destination parent through apply; staged and applied bytes are checked; restore installs with no-replace link semantics.
descriptor_review.independent_reproduction: At after_prepared hook, rename original project root and create a replacement directory containing sentinel artifact. Complete mutation using original harness. Verified original retained directory contains accepted bytes, replacement sentinel is unchanged, and replacement has no sidecar.
descriptor_review.suite_coverage: 113-case independent rerun includes concurrent leaf symlink swaps, deterministic post-check leaf swap, parent/root replacement, hardlinked staging, FIFO denial, sidecar/lock symlinks, staged-source swap and no-replace restore race.
descriptor_review.outcome: Reviewed descriptor containment and current suite pass on this macOS host; no new concrete containment failure reproduced.

conclusion: The reviewed JSON model suite passes and the three independently demonstrated defects are repaired. Descriptor confinement has host-tested evidence. This is not full Gate D acceptance.
limitations: No embedded Helix/Ladybug transaction or WAL integration verified.
No hardware power-loss durability, real disk-full fault, cloud/network filesystem behavior or Linux parity verified.

Concurrent external regular-file edits after final hash check cannot be atomically excluded by the current rename protocol; Unicode/case equivalence and cross-platform filesystem parity remain unverified.
External attempt ledger is an in-memory semantics fixture, not durable production recovery.
Profile restore is a JSON fixture; production profile adapter/journal integration remains unverified.
Schema migration coordination with canonical project.toml envelope versions remains an explicit gap.
